principle: the consumer needs region/landmark identity, an explicitly available reference point, the horizontal IMAGE bearing and fresh valid observation metadata; it never gets world bearing, range, ground-truth position or an oracle region

identity.consumer_need: which landmark/region the detection is: visible_landmark_ids, landmark_match_confidence and region_candidates (7.7); choose the next visible landmark and update the region hypothesis (7.5); keep multiple hypotheses when ambiguous instead of forcing one (7.6)
identity.testable_quantity: frame-level landmark_id correctness; identity precision (claims denominator), identity recall (positive denominator) and high-confidence false-match rate on verified similar-structure negatives; ambiguous -> UNKNOWN or multiple hypotheses, never a forced single identity
identity.failure_policy: a false match is worse than a miss: claim landmark_id only with class evidence + a single candidate / accepted margin + an appearance gate; otherwise UNKNOWN
identity.current_evidence: single-class frozen model gave 0/9 false identity claims on MS1-alone development frames but has no identity channel; 9/9 is not a certification denominator (95% upper bound 28.3%); a retrained v4 baseline detected MS1 as a second candidate in 1/30 inner_north frames

reference_availability.consumer_need: a stable physical reference point for the bearing; if the reference point is not visible there is no anchor and the consumer must reject/UNKNOWN instead of guessing (7.6)
reference_availability.testable_quantity: correct UNAVAILABLE declarations on GT-unavailable positives; false-reference rate on GT-unavailable positives; reference coverage denominator = positives with an available GT reference point; presence misses and non-emitted keypoints stay in the coverage denominator
reference_availability.failure_policy: emit a keypoint only when it is observed; otherwise explicit UNAVAILABLE with a reason; never a placeholder coordinate
reference_availability.current_evidence: old final: 20/20 correct UNAVAILABLE declarations, 0/20 false references; coverage 62/218=0.284 at tau_px=3.0; 37 no-keypoint emissions = 28 confidence suppressed + 9 presence misses

horizontal_image_bearing.consumer_need: coarse_heading_sector / image bearing for the region-level next step (7.7); the bearing is an image angle atan2(x_px - cx_px, fx_px), not a world bearing and not a range
horizontal_image_bearing.testable_quantity: absolute error of the image bearing versus the labelled reference point, reported as median/P90 on emitted keypoints (error-distribution denominator) and as a pass rate over every applicable frame (availability+misse s denominator); the historical 3 px 2D rule is reported separately as a legacy proxy
horizontal_image_bearing.failure_policy: no bearing without an available reference point; no world bearing/distance claim from this module; invalid -> explicit reason
horizontal_image_bearing.current_evidence: old final emitted 181 keypoints: image bearing median 0.546 deg / P90 1.188 deg / max 2.248 deg; 87/181 fail the legacy 3 px 2D rule but pass the 1.074 deg single-axis equivalent; bearing<=1.074 deg usable 149/218=0.683, <=3 deg 181/218=0.830

bearing_budget_deg.source: LANDMARK_TASK_AND_EXPERIMENT_DEFINITION_20261104.md section 2.2 (adopted as the working consumer budget; not yet frozen by lead)
bearing_budget_deg.legacy_proxy: the historical 3 px 2D rule is about 1.074 deg at fx=160 and is NOT the consumer unit

freshness_and_validity.consumer_need: timestamp, localization_epoch, valid flag and sensor age/quality; stale, duplicate, generation-mismatched or invalid observations must be rejected, never zero-filled (11.1 Student inputs include sensor quality, validity and data age)
freshness_and_validity.testable_quantity: explicit validity/reason fields present; age <= allowed_age_ns; generation monotonic; duplicate/stale rejection; capture_time_source and exposure status declared
freshness_and_validity.failure_policy: reject with an explicit reason; no zero substitution; no re-stamping to extend TTL; absence is not proof the landmark does not exist
freshness_and_validity.current_evidence: v2 observation/consumer contract and TTL rejection tests exist; the simulated sensor capture_time is SIM_UPDATE_SAMPLE_TIME, not a real exposure time; full camera-to-consumer latency is UNKNOWN

protocol.identity_rule: claim landmark_id only if class evidence exists AND the appearance gate passes AND (single candidate or accepted margin); otherwise UNKNOWN with candidate count; a single-class tower output must never be mapped unconditionally to the central tower id

appearance_gate_proposed.applies_when: bbox height >= 20 px; below that identity=UNKNOWN
appearance_gate_proposed.basis: 62 development identity frames, 44 target / 35 MS1 objects: aspect 0.632-1.778 vs 0.201-0.438; green_rel_y 0.212-0.396 vs 0.062-0.122 (AUC 1.0 each on this sample)

protocol.reference_rule: reference point/bearing only when visible; otherwise explicit UNAVAILABLE + reason

bearing_budget_deg.source: LANDMARK_TASK_AND_EXPERIMENT_DEFINITION_20261104.md section 2.2 (adopted as the working consumer budget; not yet frozen by lead)
bearing_budget_deg.legacy_proxy: the historical 3 px 2D rule is about 1.074 deg at fx=160 and is NOT the consumer unit

protocol.bearing_definition: atan2(x_px - cx_px, fx_px); image angle only

freshness_rule.status: PROPOSED; actual camera-to-consumer latency and exposure are UNKNOWN

protocol.evaluation_mapping: presence / identity / reference-availability / localization are separate; joint is a composite and is not a consumer metric; the identity precision denominator is claims, the recall denominator is positives, the localization denominator is available-reference positives
applicability_domain: valid for the current 320x240 synthetic development domain
identity gate not valid below ~20 px bbox height (TINY 9-14 px blind annotation: 12/12 undecidable)
no certification, no real-arena distribution, no board timing

boundaries: internal bounded research only; distribution pending
not a certification or sealed-final claim
